ROBOT STYLE BLOCK 1.
Rendering: a funny flat cel-shaded editorial cartoon of a machine, with a clean hand-inked look. This is a silly satirical cartoon. It is not a concept-art render.
Construction: keep the construction, the proportions, the parts, and the base colors of the robot in the attached image. Use the surface condition that this prompt gives. The robot is fully mechanical. Give it no skin, hair, flesh, or human anatomy.
Face: draw the display or the face plate with a small number of flat shapes. Use no gradients and no highlight modeling. A lit display is a flat bright color.
Contours: one uniform bold dark ink line goes around the complete outer silhouette. On a canvas of 1254 pixels, this line is 3.5 pixels wide. On a larger canvas, it is wider in proportion. It has the same width on the head, the arms, the body, and the legs or wheels. Interior lines are thinner and sparse. Use no broken, sketchy, tapered, or colored outlines.
Shading: each material has one flat base color and one hard-edged shadow color. Draw oxide as flat patches of one color with hard irregular edges. Draw polish as a small number of hard-edged highlight shapes. Use no soft gradients, airbrush, brushed-metal texture, mirror reflections, rim light, or glow.
Detail: panels use large clean shapes. Draw twelve or fewer rivets. Use no tiny pattern, fine scratches, speckles, grime, or decorative noise.
Not permitted: a realistic machine, a three-dimensional render, painterly blending, anime, a minimalist vector icon, a sticker border, light that the display throws on the body, or a face that has a different rendering technique from the body.
